name: code-puppy-bounded-provider-payloads-and-e70e
instr:
code-puppy cannot bound provider and MCP HTTP payloads, allowing unbounded memory use or truncated success. Add deterministic limits while preserving provider transformations, retries, client families, response interfaces, authentication, headers, timeouts, and permissive-limit behavior.

Immutable `PayloadPolicy` values from `code_puppy.payload_limits` use positive thresholds, memory no greater than total response capacity, provider-scoped defaults, and `PayloadPolicyError`, a `ValueError`, for invalid policies. `PayloadDisposition` is an Enum. `PayloadLimitExceeded` is an Exception. Each bounded attempt measures the final transformed request once and rejects oversize data before transmission. `PayloadMeter`, constructed with `policy`, provides `report()` for logical-send accounting. Declared or streamed overflow closes resources; success contains every byte. `PayloadSpool` from `code_puppy.payload_spool`, constructed with `policy`, spills owner-private, readable content securely until response ownership ends and cleans up deterministically after failure. Emit one immutable `PayloadObservation` per logical send through `register_payload_observer` from `code_puppy.payload_observation`; observer failures cannot change results.
